Trải nghiệm bất ngờ
Mar 2023 • Solo
Looking for a place to chill on google, I accidentally came across the rooftop bar located at 118 pasteur on the rooftop of the SAIGON118 building. The first thing I walked in was the enthusiastic reception of the staff and I was taken care of by you so much to be able to go to the rooftop bar, as soon as I arrived, I caught my eye with a very beautiful view overlooking the street. Nguyen Hue and SAIGON CENTER building. I was guided by a Bartender to sit and order, the menu is very diverse from dishes to drinks. and that day my mood was suitable for a graught beer. I sat for a while, so trying to order the food, my experience was an excellent night because the food was very tasty even though I am very picky. In short, this experience is perfect even if you go alone, but it will be great if you go with friends.
